item.title: Referral
item.description:
Everyone uses some form of service. Below are ones I’ve actually use and like. If you’re going to use one of these anyways, there’s no downside to signing up through my links.

OVO Energy

ovoenergy.com.au/refer/kevin5298

Electricity (and gas) provider. Has great rates and plans. Their web portal & app lets you see your usage pretty well. The free electricity window is excellent for anyone working from home.
